findings.title: Team permission check uses AND instead of OR
findings.body: In addGuests.handler.ts the isTeamAdminOrOwner flag is computed as (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)). This requires the caller to be both admin AND owner at the same time, so a team admin who is not an owner (and vice versa) is denied. Combined with the later FORBIDDEN check, legitimate team admins/owners cannot add guests unless they are also organizer/attendee. It should be OR.

findings.title: Duplicate/blacklist checks are case-sensitive and bypassable
findings.body: uniqueGuests is filtered with guest === attendee.email and blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest), but only the blacklist is lowercased. An existing attendee Guest@x.com can be re-added as guest@x.com, and a blacklisted address can bypass by case. Server schema also does not normalize email case, so duplicate Attendee rows with different case can be created.

findings.title: Wrong guest list passed to email sender misclassifies attendees
findings.body: Handler computes uniqueGuests (deduplicated against existing attendees and blacklist) for DB insert, but calls sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) with the raw input. In email-manager.ts sendAddGuestsEmails decides new vs existing by newGuests.includes(attendee.email). An already-existing attendee re-submitted in guests will therefore receive the new-guest AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail, and filtered/blacklisted addresses affect classification. Pass uniqueGuests.

findings.title: No booking status check allows adding guests to cancelled/past/rejected bookings
findings.body: Handler only checks booking existence, then inserts new Attendee rows and calls eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees and sends emails. There is no guard for status CANCELLED/REJECTED or endTime in the past. Adding attendees to a cancelled or finished meeting corrupts data, updates calendars incorrectly, and sends confusing invites. Reject non-ACCEPTED/PENDING or past bookings.

findings.title: Server schema allows duplicate and unbounded guest lists
findings.body: ZAddGuestsInputSchema is z.array(z.string().email()) with no uniqueness refinement, min/max, or normalization, while the client dialog enforces uniqueness. A direct API call can submit ["a@x.com","a@x.com"] causing duplicate Attendee creates (or DB unique errors) and can submit an arbitrarily large array, spamming calendar/email updates. Enforce unique, lowercase, and a reasonable max length server-side.

findings.title: Validation error flag is never cleared on valid input
findings.body: handleAdd sets isInvalidEmail(true) on failed safeParse but never sets it back to false when validation succeeds. Once shown, the emails_must_be_unique_valid error persists even after the user fixes the emails and on subsequent opens until Cancel, confusing users. Reset the flag on successful validation/change.

findings.title: DB write not atomic with calendar update, leaves partial state on failure
findings.body: Attendees are persisted via prisma.booking.update createMany before eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees. If the calendar update throws, the DB already contains the new guests but calendars/emails are not updated, with no rollback or compensation. Wrap in a transaction-safe order or clean up / surface the failure instead of diverging sources of truth.
